edits.old: Then no second access-log entry is written for that call
edits.new:
Then no second access-log entry is written for that call

  Scenario: AC11 A decision record that cannot be written returns 503 and no answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision-record fake forces the write of the access entry to fail
    When "U-9212" asks the authorise path for area "LITIGATION" and right "R" on notice "N-0201"
    Then the call returns status 503 and message MSG-P7-003
    Then the call holds no answer and no data and the cache is unchanged

  Scenario: AC12 A second call with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "U-9212" has made an authorise call with an Idempotency-Key for area "LITIGATION" and right "R" on notice "N-0201"
    When the second call arrives with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second access-log entry is written

  Scenario: AC13 An authorise call without a valid caller session is refused with 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the authorise call carries no valid caller session
    When the call is made to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise for area "LITIGATION" and right "R" on notice "N-0201"
    Then the call is refused with status 401
    Then the call holds no answer and no data

  Scenario: AC14 A replayed write with the same Idempotency-Key answers with the first answer's versions (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "U-9212" has made an authorise call with an Idempotency-Key for area "LITIGATION" and right "R" and received matrix version "PM-2026.12" and masking version "MASK-SIT-01"
    When the replay arrives with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the replay answers with matrix version "PM-2026.12" and masking version "MASK-SIT-01" and no second access-log entry is written
